_comment: How each car looks in the Unreal client (Source/SimCruise/*/Presentation). Physics stays in game/cars/<id>.json. Boxes and points use the Unreal vehicle frame: X forward, Y right, Z up, metres, origin midway between the axles at the physics body origin. Colours are "#rrggbb" sRGB. Roles: see SimCruiseCarMaterialRoles.h. Every value that copies a real car names its source.

nb1999.credit: "Mazda MX-5 (NB) convertible HQ interior" by Nieve5677 (https://sketchfab.com/niev), CC BY 4.0
nb1999.steering_ratio_source: 15:1 overall, power rack, 2.6 turns lock to lock (GoAuto, 2001 MX-5 review; the NB power rack is the same 1999-2005).

paint.name: Emerald Mica (DU)
paint.source: 1999 NB Emerald Mica, a mica green; matched by eye to the green 1999 cars in the taste references (Kevauto front/rear 4.28.18, DestinationFearFan 1999 Mazda MX-5 Miata), which read lighter and less blue than the Godot build's #0f3b2a.

mustang65.credit: "1965 Ford Mustang Convertible" by Kristian LaGrange (https://sketchfab.com/kristian123), CC BY 4.0
mustang65.steering_ratio_source: 21.7:1 manual, 3.73 turns lock to lock (Ford specifications, as in chassis).

paint.name: Atlas paint (author texture)
paint.source: The model's atlas carries its own body colour; 1965 enamel was solid (non-metallic) with a heavier orange peel than modern clear coats.

badges.note: FORD letters on the bonnet lip

meridian_z.credit: "2019 Chevrolet Corvette C8 Stingray" by Hari Prasath R (https://sketchfab.com/Haris3D), CC BY 4.0
meridian_z.steering_ratio_source: 15.7:1, variable-ratio electric rack (Chevrolet, 2020 Corvette Stingray specifications; 16.25:1 on the C7).

paint.name: Torch Red (GKZ)
paint.source: C8 Torch Red, a solid red; the model's Body_Color factor (0.539, 0.015, 0.010 linear) is the same hue.
